RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' 'dir="${COMPUTE_STATE_DIR:-/var/lib/duckstream}/risingwave"' 'mkdir -p "$dir/state_store"' 'printf "%s\n" "[meta]" "min_sst_retention_time_sec = 300" "full_gc_interval_sec = 60" "vacuum_interval_sec = 15" "gc_history_retention_time_sec = 0" "clean_all_foreground_jobs_on_recovery = true" "" "[meta.developer]" "actor_cnt_per_worker_parallelism_soft_limit = 1000" "actor_cnt_per_worker_parallelism_hard_limit = 4000" "" "[streaming]" "in_flight_barrier_nums = 256" "" "[streaming.developer]" "enable_snapshot_backfill = false" "" "[storage]" "shared_buffer_min_batch_flush_size_mb = 32" > "$dir/risingwave.toml"' 'compute_mem="${RISINGWAVE_MEMORY_BYTES:-1342177280}"' 'parallelism="${RISINGWAVE_PARALLELISM:-2}"' 'exec /risingwave/bin/risingwave standalone --config-path "$dir/risingwave.toml" \' '  --meta-opts="--listen-addr 127.0.0.1:5690 --advertise-addr 127.0.0.1:5690 --backend sqlite --sql-endpoint $dir/metadata.db --state-store hummock+fs://$dir/state_store --data-directory hummock_001" \' '  --compute-opts="--listen-addr 127.0.0.1:5688 --meta-address http://127.0.0.1:5690 --total-memory-bytes $compute_mem --role both --parallelism $parallelism" \' '  --frontend-opts="--listen-addr 0.0.0.0:4566 --meta-addr http://127.0.0.1:5690 --frontend-total-memory-bytes 268435456" \' '  --compactor-opts="--listen-addr 127.0.0.1:6660 --meta-address http://127.0.0.1:5690 --compactor-total-memory-bytes 1073741824 --compactor-meta-cache-memory-bytes 67108864"' > /usr/local/bin/appliance-risingwave.sh && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/appliance-risingwave.sh

COPY <<'APPLIANCE' /.bayt/process-compose.appliance.yaml
version: "0.5"
processes:
  airlock-upgrade:
    command: '''psql'' ''postgres://${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}@database:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-golaberto}'' ''-X'' ''--set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1'' ''--single-transaction'' ''--file=/airlock-upgrade.sql'''
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: process_healthy
  airlock-mesh:
    command: '''/daprd'' ''--app-id'' ''airlock'' ''--dapr-listen-addresses'' ''127.0.0.1'' ''--dapr-internal-grpc-listen-address'' ''127.0.0.1'' ''--resources-path'' ''/dapr/airlock'' ''--config'' ''/dapr/config.yaml'' ''--dapr-http-port'' ''3500'' ''--dapr-grpc-port'' ''50001'' ''--dapr-internal-grpc-port'' ''50002'' ''--metrics-port'' ''0'' ''--profile-port'' ''0'' ''--log-level'' ''info'''
    depends_on:
      sofascore:
        condition: process_healthy
    environment:
      - BRIDGE_SOFASCORE_URL=http://sofascore:8081
    readiness_probe:
      exec:
        command: portcheck --port 3500
      period_seconds: 1
      timeout_seconds: 5
      failure_threshold: 120
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      exit_on_end: true
  airlock:
    command: '''airlock-deno'' ''run'' ''--frozen'' ''--unstable-worker-options'' ''--allow-net=database:5432,airlock-mesh:3500,0.0.0.0:9997'' ''--allow-read'' ''--allow-env'' ''--allow-sys'' ''main.ts'''
    working_dir: /app/airlock
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}@database:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-golaberto}
      - MESH_URL=http://airlock-mesh:3500
      - AIRLOCK_DIR=/airlock
      - DENO_DIR=/airlock-deno-dir
      - PORT=9997
      - AIRLOCK_RELEASE=docker
      - AIRLOCK_SEAL_DEV=
      - AIRLOCK_TARGET=docker
    depends_on:
      airlock-upgrade:
        condition: process_completed_successfully
      airlock-mesh:
        condition: process_healthy
    readiness_probe:
      exec:
        command: portcheck --port 9997
      period_seconds: 1
      timeout_seconds: 5
      failure_threshold: 120
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      exit_on_end: true
  database:
    command: '''docker-entrypoint.sh'' ''postgres'' ''-c'' ''session_preload_libraries=pg_ivm'' ''-c'' ''wal_level=logical'' ''-c'' ''max_replication_slots=128'' ''-c'' ''max_wal_senders=128'' ''-c'' ''fsync=off'' ''-c'' ''synchronous_commit=off'' ''-c'' ''full_page_writes=off'' ''-c'' ''shared_buffers=32MB'' ''-c'' ''max_connections=200'' ''-c'' ''fsync=on'' ''-c'' ''synchronous_commit=on'' ''-c'' ''full_page_writes=on'' ''-c'' ''shared_buffers=512MB'''
  electric:
    availability:
      exit_on_end: true
    command: '''env'' ''DATABASE_URL=postgresql://electric:${ELECTRIC_PASSWORD:-dev-electric-password}@127.0.0.1:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-golaberto}?sslmode=disable'' ''ELECTRIC_SECRET=${ELECTRIC_SECRET:-dev-electric-secret}'' ''ELECTRIC_MANUAL_TABLE_PUBLISHING=true'' ''ELECTRIC_PORT=3002'' ''ELECTRIC_STORAGE_DIR=${PGDATA:-/var/lib/pgsql/data}/electric'' ''LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/electric-libs'' ''ELIXIR_ERL_OPTIONS=+fnu'' ''/electric-app/bin/entrypoint'' ''start'''
  risingwave:
    command: '''/usr/local/bin/appliance-risingwave.sh'''
    environment:
      - CONNECTOR_LIBS_PATH=/risingwave/bin/connector-node/libs
      - ADBC_DRIVER_PATH=/risingwave/lib/adbc
      - LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/risingwave/lib:/risingwave/lib/adbc:/risingwave/jre/lib/server
      - JAVA_HOME=/risingwave/jre
      - JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Xmx256m
      - PATH=/risingwave/jre/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
      - ENABLE_TELEMETRY=false
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: process_healthy
    readiness_probe:
      exec:
        command: portcheck --port 4566
      period_seconds: 1
      timeout_seconds: 5
      failure_threshold: 120
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      exit_on_end: true
  ticker:
    command: '''ticker-deno'' ''run'' ''--frozen'' ''--allow-net'' ''--allow-env'' ''main.ts'''
    working_dir: /ticker-app
    environment:
      - CRUD_URL=http://crud:3000
      - CALL_TIMEOUT_MS=35000
      - SERVICE_JWT=${SERVICE_JWT:-eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJtZWNoYTpzdGFjayIsInJvbGUiOiJzZXJ2aWNlIiwic3ViIjoiMDAwMDAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwIiwiZXhwIjoxOTg4MTUwNDAwfQ.K4ZX9EDs-BwPIh3r_ZOKmO9XfrQrEx18rwlw3siXcxs}
      - DENO_DIR=/ticker-deno-dir
      - PORT=9998
      - WAKE_URLS=http://airlock:9997/healthz
    depends_on:
      crud:
        condition: process_healthy
    readiness_probe:
      exec:
        command: portcheck --port 9998
      period_seconds: 1
      timeout_seconds: 5
      failure_threshold: 120
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      exit_on_end: true
  clock:
    command: '''/usr/local/bin/appliance-clock.sh'''
    environment:
      - SERVICE_JWT=${SERVICE_JWT:-eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJtZWNoYTpzdGFjayIsInJvbGUiOiJzZXJ2aWNlIiwic3ViIjoiMDAwMDAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwIiwiZXhwIjoxOTg4MTUwNDAwfQ.K4ZX9EDs-BwPIh3r_ZOKmO9XfrQrEx18rwlw3siXcxs}
    depends_on:
      ticker:
        condition: process_healthy
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      exit_on_end: true
  timer-check:
    command: '''psql'' ''-X'' ''--set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1'' ''--single-transaction'' ''--file=/timer-check.sql'''
  transform:
    availability:
      exit_on_end: true
    environment:
      - CDC_GROUPS=["golaberto-matches-games","golaberto-recent-championships","golaberto-rounds","golaberto-sofascore-admission","golaberto-team-directory","golaberto-team-enrichment","golaberto-team-profiles"]
  render:
    availability:
      exit_on_end: true
  mesh-events:
    availability:
      exit_on_end: true
  conduit:
    availability:
      exit_on_end: true
  compute:
    availability:
      exit_on_end: true
  sofascore:
    command: '''/usr/local/bin/sofascore_fetch'' ''--listen'' ''127.0.0.1:8081'''
    readiness_probe:
      exec:
        command: portcheck --port 8081
      period_seconds: 1
      timeout_seconds: 5
      failure_threshold: 120
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      exit_on_end: true
APPLIANCE

RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -e' 'while sleep "${POKE_INTERVAL_SECONDS:-60}"; do' '  curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SERVICE_JWT}" "http://ticker:9998/poke?caller=appliance" >/dev/null || { echo "clock: the ticker refused its poke" >&2; exit 1; }' 'done' > /usr/local/bin/appliance-clock.sh && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/appliance-clock.sh

'      setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -f "$f"' '      base=$(basename "$f")' '      setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "INSERT INTO _pronto_migrations (name) VALUES ($q$base$q) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING"' '    fi' '  done' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -m fast -w stop' 'else' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -w -o "-c listen_addresses='\'''\'' $*" start' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _pronto_migrations (name text primary key, applied_at timestamptz default now())"' '  for f in /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/*.sql; do' '    if [ -f "$f" ]; then' '      base=$(basename "$f")' '      case "$base" in *seed*) continue;; esac' '      applied=$(setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -t -A -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "SELECT count(*) FROM _pronto_migrations WHERE name = $q$base$q")' '      if [ "$applied" = "0" ]; then' '        echo "Applying pending migration $f..."' RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'if [ "$1" = "microcheck" ]; then' '  shift' '  exec "$@"' 'fi' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/bayt && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/bayt
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; break; fi; shift; done' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/mise && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/mise

RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -e' 'for n in crud database auth airlock-mesh airlock ticker risingwave sofascore; do' '  grep -Eq "^[^#]*[[:space:]]$n([[:space:]]|$)" /etc/hosts || echo "127.0.0.1 $n" >> /etc/hosts || { echo "appliance: cannot name $n in /etc/hosts" >&2; exit 1; }' 'done' 'export PORT="${PORT:-8080}"' 'if [ "$PORT" = 8081 ]; then echo "appliance: PORT 8081 is where the bridge process sofascore listens; set another" >&2; exit 1; fi' 'export CADDY_HTTP_PORT="${PORT}"' 'export CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT="${PORT}"' 'if [ -n "$ORIGIN" ]; then' '  if [ -z "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" ]; then' '    h="${ORIGIN#*://}"' '    h="${h%%/*}"' '    h="${h%%:*}"' '    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ "$h" != "localhost" ]; then export WEBAUTHN_RP_ID="$h"; fi' '  fi' '  if [ -z "$WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN" ] && [ -n "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" ] && [ "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" != "localhost" ]; then export WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN="$ORIGIN"; fi' 'fi' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/appliance-entrypoint.sh && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/appliance-entrypoint.sh

RUN awk 'skip { d += gsub(/\{/, "{") - gsub(/\}/, "}"); if (d <= 0) skip = 0; next } /handle @rendered \{/ { skip = 1; d = 1; next } { print }' /etc/caddy/Caddyfile > /tmp/Caddyfile && mv /tmp/Caddyfile /etc/caddy/Caddyfile

RUN nu -c 'let f = "/dapr/airlock/acquire.yaml"; let b = (open $f); if $b.spec.baseUrl != "http://sofascore:8080" { error make {msg: "appliance: unexpected bridge endpoint in acquire"} }; $b | upsert spec.baseUrl "http://sofascore:8081" | to yaml | save -f $f'

RUN nu -c 'let f = "/.bayt/process-compose.yaml"; open $f | upsert processes.compute.depends_on.risingwave {condition: "process_healthy"} | if ("transform" in $in.processes) { update processes.transform.entrypoint {|p| $p.processes.transform.entrypoint | each {|a| $a | str replace " ($$cdir | path join '\''events.yaml'\'')" "" } } } else { $in } | to yaml | save -f $f'

RUN ports="8081"; for p in $ports; do if grep -Eq ":-$p\}" /.bayt/process-compose.yaml; then echo "appliance: bridge port $p is one an appliance process takes; name another" >&2; exit 1; fi; done; dup="$(printf '%s\n' $ports | sort | uniq -d)"; if [ -n "$dup" ]; then echo "appliance: bridges share port $dup" >&2; exit 1; fi
